items.quote: The MCP tool-roster versus COVERAGE.md cross-check runs again.
A chat() or embed() whose response has usage=None returns TokenAccounting with call_count == 1 and counted_by == 'unbudgetable'.
OpenAICompatibleClient no longer passes malformed provider responses to callers unchecked
returns True when the real mcp distribution is installed in the active virtualenv
Model clients are built by one shipped builder that both the parity CLIs and the launcher use.
Both transports can be started from the installed package.
The launcher enforces one engine process and one uvicorn worker per store root
A browser console on another origin can call the REST seam, or the decision to serve same-origin is enforced and documented.
The REST upload path-safety test in databasise/tests/seam/test_rest_corpus_endpoints.py:345-356 checks the file actually written to disk.
The upload-poll-delete round-trip tests prove that counts change after a delete.
Phase gate: the offline test suite is green under both invocation styles.
